integrity_notes: General result is proved by a disjoint-shell injection and complementary-divisor reversal. The 695 finite coefficient is checked by two independent exhaustive integer algorithms over all 23 proper reciprocal-divisor pairs; finite shell tests verify several cases but are not offered as proof of all powers.
scientific_limitations: Theorem provides exact counts only inside the palindromic shell-lift class and a lower bound for unrestricted representations, not a full classification or optimal exponent. Base r(45045)=695 is already tabulated by Wang and Zelinsky and is independently enumerated here; originality is in quantified power amplification. Prior literature may contain an implicit unstated form of the shell argument; the conclusion has not been independently audited.
title: Palindromic shell amplification of strongly pseudoperfect representations
